items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Like Willie Smith had gone, Crawford, you know. And that was the tail end of Jimmy Lunceford days, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. And I just got my -- you know, I just said, if everybody else can do it, I can do it. That's been sort of my philosophy. If I start feeling sorry for myself I say, well, Willie had the same thing happen to them, whoever, and they've come out victorious so how come I can't do it, you know. If anybody else can do something, so can I.
But I can see why that would be a little tragedy.
